name: Upbound Group (Rent-A-Center/Acima/Brigit)
verdict: WAIT for the Jul-30 print, then conditional RP_FAIR carry <=0.5% sleeve if the gate passes (LCO<=9.5% + ~$200M FCF guide held + no dividend-language change). Prefer buying the post-print fade (UPBD-STK 0.45). NOT deep value (GAAP 17.4x) — this is a carry position.
entry_band: NO entry pre-print (84th-pctile IV — don't pay the event premium). Post-print on gate-pass: tranche <=0.5% sleeve, prefer a fade toward $20; kill if gate fails.
kill_triggers: NYAG usury ruling against the LTO pricing model (recharacterization = model risk, not a fine)
Brigit advance-book losses spike with Acima's (procyclical correlation confirmed)

court_record.dd: 6.5/10 (Opus). '5.3x EPS' REFUTED as stated — adjusted ($212M add-backs); GAAP 17.4x, EV/EBIT ~11x. Balance-sheet death spiral REFUTED (covenant-lite, no wall till 2029, >$460M liquidity, 2.6x falling). FCF real ($180.5M FY25/$200M guided; div 2.0x FCF-covered, 122% of GAAP NI). LCO 8.9->10.1->8.8 as guided. Acima GMV -5.9% Q1'26 (first decline in 9 qtrs; ~200bps deliberate tightening; demand tells co-present). NYAG live; 43-state ~$72M accrued. Brigit scaling (EBITDA 2x) but correlated $59M advance book.
court_record.red_fable: 7/10 PASS. Headline: after-tax carry NEGATIVE vs MMF (7.2%x50% CA = 3.5% vs 4.2%). Also: tightening bought only 10bps net LCO; add-backs ~3x GAAP NI with 'one-time' legal recurring annually; NYAG = model-recharacterization risk not a line item; Brigit procyclical at 6.7x book; crowded entry (+26% YTD, 84th-pctile IV).
court_record.blue_fable: 6.5/10 WAIT-with-gate. RED'S HEADLINE INVERTED: UPBD dividend is QUALIFIED (~37.1% all-in) -> ~4.5% net, while the MMF's 4.2% is ORDINARY (~54%) -> ~1.9% net = +260bps POSITIVE carry; red taxed the qualified leg at ordinary and the ordinary leg at zero. Add-backs dominated by acquisition-intangible amortization (non-cash purchase accounting) — cash covers the dividend 2.0-2.3x; '122% of GAAP NI' measures purchase accounting. 10.1 peak was GUIDED AND DELIVERED THROUGH = soft landing. CONCEDED: crowded entry (timing->wait), NYAG tail (size cap), Brigit correlation (size), recurring-legal sliver of add-backs.
court_record.presiding_adjudication: Blue's tax correction is decisive — the PASS headline was an arithmetic inversion (both legs must be taxed at their own character: qualified ~37% vs ordinary ~54% — see the metric-conflation memory). Red's surviving points are all doctrine-handled: crowding->WAIT (no pre-print entry, don't pay 84th-pctile IV), tails->0.5% cap. Gate adopted verbatim from blue; two-call pair frozen (UPBD 0.62 gate / UPBD-STK 0.45 reaction — an expected-good print more likely fades, and the fade IS the entry).

edge_explainer.market_believes: Subprime lease-to-own is a melting, regulation-hounded business — the 7% yield is a trap coupon.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The credit curve landed exactly as guided four straight quarters, the balance sheet has no mechanical trigger before 2029, cash covers the dividend twice, and the qualified-dividend character makes the after-tax carry ~4.5% vs ~1.9% for cash — fairly-paid risk, IF Jul-30 confirms the soft landing.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None claimed — this is RP_FAIR carry (the deploying-book default class), not edge. The only 'edge' is tax-structural: qualified-dividend character vs ordinary-income alternatives.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: +26% YTD with bullish sell-side — the recovery IS priced; that's why entry waits for the gate and prefers the post-print fade.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Jul-30 Q2 (frozen 0.62/0.45 pair): LCO, FCF guide, dividend language.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Demand-melt confirmation: GMV decline accelerating beyond tightening attribution with LCO back above 10% — red's kill path (EBIT->$135M, coverage<1.5x, cut).
edge_explainer.edge_type: RP_FAIR carry, gate-conditional, <=0.5% sleeve, taxable-book tax-character verified
